en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, raising it, said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What is more nicer regarding the seeking (the earnings rather than) the one who sails the sea for the business’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated in a marfu’ manner the following: “

Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘has said, ‘How beautiful is the quest for trade to sail on the sea!”’ [Note: H 9118 and H 9119 appear to occur during two different eras, perhaps of safe and unsafe sailing times]
